Subject: Security & Private VPC discovery - Acme Analytics

Hi Jordan — great speaking with you and Priya earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Key requirements we captured:
- Private/VPC deployment with network isolation from other tenants (dedicated subnets + NSGs)
- SOC 2 Type II report availability and expected delivery window (we discussed immediate summary + full report via secure link)
- GDPR data residency for EU users; possible regional routing for EU traffic
- Interest in air-gapped / on-prem option for controlled environments (we should map what parts need to be air-gapped: models, logs, telemetry)
- Vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) to kick off — thanks for offering to share Acme's SSQ
- Deployment diagram and expected throughput (QPS / concurrent sessions) so we can size Dedicated pools or on-prem hardware

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_security_one_pager.pdf (PDF)]

Proposed next steps:
1) Acme: share SSQ and a rough network diagram + sample throughput numbers (eg. 50 QPS, 200 concurrent) — Jordan / Priya
2) Redwood: provide SOC 2 summary and secure link to the full report; initial deployment diagram and options doc (hosted vs Dedicated vs Private on-prem) — Marcus
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive (30-45m) with our infra team to review network controls and air-gap feasibility — propose Wed or Thu next week

If that looks right, Jordan — please confirm who will own the SSQ and timeline on your side and we’ll get the secure SOC 2 link over today.

Thanks,
Marcus

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Jordan. Confirming receipt of the SSQ. Next items from our side:

- SOC 2: attaching the SOC 2 summary and we’ll share the full Type II report via a secure Drive link (see below). The full report access is auditable and time-limited.
- Deployment diagrams: attaching an initial "Private/VPC" deployment diagram (see inline below) and a short notes section on air-gapped options — happy to expand this in the technical deep-dive.
- Sizing: based on your throughput numbers (40-100 QPS), we’ll propose a Dedicated pool config and an on-prem hardware baseline if you want air-gapped.

Links & attachments:
- Secure SOC 2 link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-secure-soc2-link
- Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf

Inline deployment sketch (high level):
- Customer VPC with private subnets hosting Redwood sidecar connectors -> Traffic routed via private link / VPC peering; control plane (Redwood) managed separately with encrypted control channel.
- Option A (Hosted Private VPC): Dedicated GPU pool in our cloud region, customer VPC peering, strict ingress/egress controls, KV cache not shared across tenants.
- Option B (Private on-prem): On-prem appliance or VM bundle, models and KV cache contained locally; audit logs pushed to customer's SIEM; options for fully air-gapped mode with offline model sync via secure media.

Action items:
- Jordan/Priya: confirm SSQ owner and timeline (sounds like Priya, due 2028-06-05)
- Acme: share any special legal/contract constraints for on-prem or air-gapped deployments
- Redwood: we’ll schedule the infra deep-dive — Marcus to propose times

Regards,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf]
